WITH joined AS (
  SELECT s.transref, t.trdref, tr.tradekind, s.optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg
  JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS overall_avg FROM joined
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT j.transref, j.tradekind, AVG(j.optvolrt) AS pair_avg
  FROM joined j
  GROUP BY j.transref, j.tradekind
),
dev AS (
  SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.pair_avg, p.pair_avg - o.overall_avg AS deviation
  FROM pairs p
  CROSS JOIN overall o
),
typed AS (
  SELECT d.tradekind, d.pair_avg, d.deviation,
         AVG(d.deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY d.tradekind) AS type_avg_dev
  FROM dev d
  WHERE d.tradekind IS NOT NULL
),
kept AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind, t.pair_avg, t.deviation, t.deviation - t.type_avg_dev AS excess
  FROM typed t
  WHERE t.deviation > t.type_avg_dev
)
SELECT k.tradekind,
       AVG(k.pair_avg) AS avg_optvolrt,
       AVG(k.deviation) AS avg_deviation,
       AVG(k.excess) AS avg_excess
FROM kept k
GROUP BY k.tradekind
ORDER BY k.tradekind;
